events.title: Osvaldo Ardiles is sacked after 16 months as manager of 토트넘 홋스퍼. 에버턴 finally win a Premier League game at the 13th attempt by beating 웨스트햄 유나이티드 1–0 at Goodison Park . 입스위치 타운 boost their survival hopes with a 2–0 home win over Leeds. David Kelly scores a hat-trick for Division One leaders in a 5–1 away win over struggling 브리스틀 시티 , which adds to the home side's relegation fears. John Aldridge scores four of Tranmere's goals in their 6–1 home win over 반즐리.

맨체스터 유나이티드 lose 4–0 to 바르셀로나 at the Nou Camp in their fourth Champions League group game. In the Premier League, 크리스털 팰리스 beat Coventry 4–1 at Highfield Road to climb from 17th to 12th. 블랙번 로버스 keep up the pressure on 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 with a 1–0 win at 셰필드 웬즈데이. UEFA Cup hopefuls 노리치 시티 draw 1–1 at 사우샘프턴.
뉴캐슬 유나이티드 remain top of the Premier League with a 2–1 home win over QPR, with 블랙번 로버스 remaining second and beating 토트넘 홋스퍼 2–0 at Ewood Park .

맨체스터 유나이티드 remain firmly in the hunt with a 2–1 away win over 애스턴 빌라, still managed by 알렉스 퍼거슨 's predecessor Ron Atkinson , although Atkinson's job is reportedly on the line now that Villa have lost seven of their last eight Premier League games and are fourth from bottom, a mere 18 months after finishing runners-up to United in the first season of Premier League.
Mike Walker is sacked after 10 months as manager of 에버턴.

The Times reports that 16 Football League clubs are set to break away from the league to form a second tier of the Premier League. 리버풀 move into third place in the Premier League with a 3–1 home win over 첼시. 애스턴 빌라 lose 4–3 away to 윔블던, and have now lost eight of their last nine league games.

Ron Atkinson is sacked as manager of 애스턴 빌라, while 토트넘 홋스퍼 appoint Gerry Francis from 퀸스 파크 레인저스. 맨체스터 유나이티드 crush 맨체스터 시티 5–0 in the Manchester derby at Old Trafford, with Andrei Kanchelskis scoring a hat-trick.
Joe Royle , the longest-serving manager in England with 12 years at 올덤 애슬레틱, is named as the new manager of 에버턴.
The third round of the FA Cup is highlighted by Division Two promotion chasers 옥스퍼드 유나이티드 's 2–0 defeat at non-league club Marlow .

Ray Wilkins , 38, quits as 크리스털 팰리스 player-coach to return to 퀸스 파크 레인저스 as their new player-manager, while Brian Little resigns as manager of 레스터 시티, sparking rumours that he will take over at 애스턴 빌라.
Ajax-striker Patrick Kluivert makes his debut for the Netherlands national team , replacing Youri Mulder in the 70th minute of the Euro qualifier against the Czech Republic (0–0) in Rotterdam .

맨체스터 유나이티드 go top of the Premier League with a 3–0 home win over 크리스털 팰리스, as 뉴캐슬 유나이티드's lead of the table ends with a 3–2 defeat to 윔블던. Managerless 애스턴 빌라 win 4–3 at 토트넘 홋스퍼 but remain in the bottom four.
Joe Royle has a dream start to his reign as 에버턴 manager as they triumph 2–0 over 리버풀 in the Merseyside derby at Goodison Park and climb off the bottom of the Premier League.

Managerless 레스터 시티 boost their survival hopes with a 2–1 home win over 아스널. In the Champions League, 맨체스터 유나이티드 are left facing likely elimination after losing 3–1 to IFK Gothenburg, being reduced to 10 men after Paul Ince was sent off.b
Brian Little is named as the new 애스턴 빌라 manager on his 41st birthday.

Alan Shearer scores a hat-trick and Chris Sutton nets once as 블랙번 로버스 beat 퀸스 파크 레인저스 4–0 in the league at Ewood Park to go top of the Premier League. 맨체스터 유나이티드's short-lived lead is ended as they are held to a goalless draw at 아스널 in an ill-tempered match where Mark Hughes is sent off and Paul Ince injures his ankle blocking a shot from John Jensen . 미들즈브러 return to the top of Division One with a 2–0 win at Charlton.

블랙번 로버스 are the new month-end Premier League leaders, ahead of second-placed 맨체스터 유나이티드 by a single point, while they are two points ahead of former leaders 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 who have dipped to third place. 리버풀, 노팅엄 포리스트 and 리즈 유나이티드 are continuing to put up a strong challenge, along with a 맨체스터 시티 side who spent last season battling to avoid relegation. 에버턴's new manager Joe Royle has taken them off bottom place over the last month with their first three league wins of the season, with 입스위치 타운 and 레스터 시티 now propping up the league. Also in the relegation zone are League Cup holders 애스턴 빌라, who almost won the league title two seasons ago. 미들즈브러 finish the month as outright leaders of Division One with a two-point lead over 울버햄프턴 원더러스. 트랜미어 로버스, 볼턴 원더러스 and 루턴 타운 complete the top five, while 스윈던 타운's drastic loss of form over the last month has seen them slump from the playoff zone into 19th place and manager John Gorman sacked to be replaced by 33-year-old 맨체스터 시티 midfielder Steve McMahon , who takes over as player-manager. 포츠머스, another side who were looking like promotion contenders not so long ago, have slumped even further towards the relegation zone, only ahead of 브리스틀 시티 on goal difference. 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 and 노츠 카운티 continue to struggle.
